description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class named CursoController, which manages CRUD operations and views related to 'Curso' (courses) within the platform. It handles routing, authorization, and interaction with service and repository layers for course management.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller class responsible for handling HTTP requests related to 'Curso' entities, including adding, editing, viewing, and deleting courses, with role-based access control.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for adding a new course associated with a specified professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new course for a specified professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current course details for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing course with new data.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a specific course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to view details of a specific course, including enrollment status for the authenticated user.
